turn_text: This is the Missouri Military Minute.
I'm Ashley Berg. Missouri's Fourth District Congresswoman Vicki Hartzler had a key role in passing the National Defense Authorization Act in the U.S. House for fiscal year 2022.

That's the most important pieces of legislation that we passed. I am the ranking member of Tactical Air and Land Forces Subcommittee. We oversee all the acquisition for the Army and the Air Force and the tactical air assets for the Marines and the Navy. It's a huge portfolio and I'm very proud of the work we do there. We're going to try to get some more F-18s in the budget. We're going to continue to fund the F-15s. both made here in St. Louis Boeing and make sure that we have adequate ammunition from the Lake City ammunition plant that's just outside of Kansas City. But just in a broader picture, making sure that our men and women in uniform have what they need to meet the threat, especially from China. That is something I'm very focused on.
